items: Perform all steps in MPIS Document No. CB-030-r0 (Daily inspection)
Manually close and trip the breaker and ensure that there is no bending then lubricate with light machine oil.
Withdraw the main fusses and check mechanical parts for free movement with control switch in off position.
Clean arc chutes using fine emery cloth and examine contacts and retighten all screws.

Remove covers and check that all pins are secure examine springs, check that all adjusting screws and nuts are tighten, then lubricate with heavy machine oil after cleaning with
 benzene

Clean the contacts with emery cloth or file with a fine file if it is copper, brass, etc. but if it is silver plated do not file but clean only with dry cloth and lightly smear with 
vaseline and make sure that operating rods are well adjusted.

Check for any oil leakage, check for cracks or other damage and clean the
 porcelain.
Clean and open the plug of outlet valve at the bottom of the oil tank.
If the dielectric strength is less than 30kv/2.5 mm, dry and recondition until it with stands at least 40KV/2.5 mm.
Record all has been done in maintenance card.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines 
equipment inspection I2, to be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block.
In addition to the procedures listed, it is expected the checks, which are done 
more frequently, would also be completed at this time.
Perform all steps in MPIS Document No. CB-030-r0 (Daily inspection)
Breaker Closing Mechanism
Check the links move freely.
Manually close and trip the breaker and ensure that there is no bending then lubricate with light machine oil.
Control Relay (1 
fig. 1)
Withdraw the main fusses and check mechanical parts for free movement with control switch in off position.
Clean arc chutes using fine emery cloth and examine contacts and retighten all screws.
Connoting Rod and Clevises (2 
fig. 2)
Remove covers and check that all pins are secure examine springs, check that all adjusting screws and nuts are tighten, then lubricate with heavy machine oil after cleaning with
 benzene
Auxiliary Switches
Clean the contacts with emery cloth or file with a fine file if it is copper, brass, etc. but if it is silver plated do not file but clean only with dry cloth and lightly smear with 
vaseline and make sure that operating rods are well adjusted.
Bushings
Check for any oil leakage, check for cracks or other damage and clean the
 porcelain.
Oil in Circuit Breaker
Clean and open the plug of outlet valve at the bottom of the oil tank.
If the dielectric strength is less than 30kv/2.5 mm, dry and recondition until it with stands at least 40KV/2.5 mm.
Record all has been done in maintenance card.
